title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Cramlington, Newcastle) (Emergency) Regulations 2026
The Morecambe Offshore Windfarm Generation Assets (Correction) Order 2026
The Controlled Drugs (Drug Precursors) (Amendment and Revocation) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are made in exercise of the powers in sections 14(2), (3), (4)(a), (b), (c) and (e) and (7) and 20(1)(a) of the Retained EU Law (Revocation and Reform) Act 2023 (c. 28) (“the 2023 Act”). These Regulations revoke, replace and make alternative provision in secondary assimilated law which establish the processes and rules governing the control and trade in drug precursor chemicals in Great Britain, and trade between Great Britain, Northern Ireland and third countries.

title: The Cory Decarbonisation Project (Correction) Order 2026
summary: This Order corrects errors in the Cory Decarbonisation Project Order 2025 (S.I. 2025/1227), a development consent order made under the Planning Act 2008, following a request made under paragraph 1(5)(a) of Schedule 4 to that Act.

title: The Customs (Miscellaneous Amendments) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make various amendments to existing customs Regulations.

title: The Customs (Safety and Security Procedures) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make amendments to safety and security provisions in existing customs legislation.

title: The Dangerous Dogs (Exemption Schemes) (England and Wales) (Amendment) Order 2026
The Public Authorities (Fraud, Error and Recovery) Act 2025 (Commencement No. 3) Regulations 2026
summary: These are the third set of commencement regulations made under the Public Authorities (Fraud, Error and Recovery) Act 2025 (c. 28) (“the Act”).

title: The Agriculture (Delinked Payments) (Reductions) (England) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations make further provision in connection with the introduction of delinked payments by the Agriculture (Delinked Payments and Consequential Provisions) (England) Regulations 2023 (S.I. 2023/1430) (“the Delinked Payments Regulations”) to that made by the Agriculture (Delinked Payments) (Reductions) (England) Regulations 2024 (S.I. 2024/691) and by the Agriculture (Delinked Payments) (Reductions) (England) Regulations 2025 (S.I. 2025/568). They extend to England and Wales but apply in relation to England only.

title: The Police (Conduct) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Police (Conduct) Regulations 2020 (S.I. 2020/4) (“the Conduct Regulations”).

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Jet Formation Display Teams) Regulations 2026
The Hampshire and the Solent Combined County Authority Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations establish the Hampshire and the Solent Combined County Authority (“the Combined County Authority”) and confer certain functions of local authorities and other public authorities on the Combined County Authority.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Coventry, West Midlands) (Emergency) (Revocation) Regulations 2026
The Court Funds (Amendment) Rules 2026
summary: These Rules amend the Court Funds Rules 2011 (S.I. 2011/1734) (“the 2011 Rules”). The 2011 Rules govern the administration and management of funds in court by the Accountant General.

title: The Ministerial and other Salaries Act 1975 (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: This Order changes the annual amount of salaries payable under section 1 of the Ministerial and other Salaries Act 1975 (“the 1975 Act”) to Ministers, Opposition Leaders and Whips and the Commons and Lords Speakers. This Order also updates the formula in section 1A of the 1975 Act that provides for annual alterations of those salaries.

title: The Network Rail (Old Oak Common Great Western Mainline Track Access) Order 2026
summary: This Order confers powers on Network Rail Infrastructure Limited (referred to in this Order as Network Rail) to acquire compulsorily a right over land and to use land temporarily, as well as to use the land within the Order limits as a construction compound, including provision of a temporary ramp, all in connection with the development of a temporary road rail vehicle access onto the Great Western Mainline railway to enable delivery of the Old Oak Common station and provision of a permanent maintenance access point for road rail vehicles onto the Great Western Mainline.

title: The Inspectors of Education, Children’s Services and Skills (No. 2) Order 2026
summary: This Order appoints the persons named in the Schedule as His Majesty’s Inspectors of Education, Children’s Services and Skills.

title: The Criminal Justice (International Co-operation) Act 1990 (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: This Order amends Schedule 2 to the Criminal Justice (International Co-operation) Act 1990 (c. 5) (“the Act”) (which specifies certain substances, useful for the manufacture of controlled drugs, which are controlled under Part 2 of the Act) to add 12 drug precursor chemicals, and 16 associated esters. The amendments reflect the addition of these substances to the Annex to the United Nations Convention against Illicit Traffic in Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances 1988 (also known as the Vienna Convention) under Article 12 of that Convention.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Coventry, West Midlands) (Emergency) Regulations 2026
The Financial Services and Markets Act 2023 (Commencement No. 14) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations are the 14th commencement Regulations made under the Financial Services and Markets Act 2023 (c. 29) (“the Act”).
